title: StackChan PR #137 MicroSD music player app review

firmware.target: M5Stack StackChan (ESP32-S3, 16 MB flash / 8 MB PSRAM)
firmware.reported_partition: ota_0 0x4f0000, app 0x3caee0, 23% free; assets 4 MB at 0xA00000

execution.environment: macOS 15 arm64, ESP-IDF v6.1, xtensa-esp-elf GCC 15.2.0, local Device Service stackchan QEMU profile

checks.name: PR state and prior replies
checks.detail: OPEN, comments=[], reviews=[]; no prior m5agent reply

checks.name: device profile availability
checks.detail: stackchan profile: ESP32-S3, ILI9342C 320x240 touch, generic-flash, features.storage=false

checks.name: SD/DC pin sharing trace
checks.command: read IDF v6.1 esp_lcd_panel_io_spi.c + board file
checks.detail: GPIO35 is LCD DC and SD MISO by design; IDF disables DC output after each transaction, so MISO is readable between transactions

checks.name: visibility mask migration trace
checks.detail: MASK_KEY renamed to visible_mask_v2; old visible_mask never read; save_states writes only the mask

checks.name: virtual device boot and UI
checks.detail: MUSIC installed as 7th launcher icon, app opens, main/settings/playlist render, no-SD mount failure handled

checks.name: virtual device microSD playback
checks.detail: stackchan profile has no storage model; mount fails with ESP_ERR_INVALID_RESPONSE 0x108

checks.name: virtual device warm reboot
checks.detail: warm reboot index 6 logged and RTC_SW_CPU_RST executed; second boot stops at 'cpu_start: Multicore app' before app_main, no panic/TWDT; treated as emulator reset limitation

notes: Read-only review: no upstream push, no PR close, one comment only.
Findings F1-F7 documented with file:line in report.md; none blocking.
Author hardware claims (1,022 tracks, full build) are self-reported; build reproduced, playback not.
